response.rationale: The mechanical model clears a bid increase to defend share on a competition keyword, but realized dROAS (1.87) misses the target (2.22) by ~16%, indicating efficiency headwinds that would be exacerbated by a full step-up. Recent order volume (22) also limits statistical certainty. Rather than fully endorsing or flatly rejecting the +10% proposal, a moderate dampener tests incremental reach while constraining downside risk on profitability.
